bullets: Removed unopened AI model rows from the held Freebuff catalog so models not yet scheduled to open never appear for selection.
Fixed the CLI first-tab discount to read its quote from the same Desktop purchase store an active session owns, so model switches keep applying the discount.
Made MiMo 2.6 Flash the default Freebuff model across CLI, desktop, web, and SDK, replacing GLM 5.3 Flash.
Added terminal output sanitization before CLI rendering to strip escape sequences like clipboard writes and window titles from tool and process output.
Removed Kimi K3 Eco from the paid subscriber catalog models after its provider retired on 2026-10-01.
Stopped running landing screen ad auctions on terminals shorter than 18 rows by disabling the ad hook below the banner floor.
Made the sponsored run command walk refuse history-changing git subcommands nested in wrappers, failing closed on overly deep or undecodable forms.
Pinned the SDK read URL tool to an address validated in the same DNS resolution so it cannot connect to blocked hosts.
Installed completed deferred CLI updates on the next launcher restart when a prior download was interrupted by closing the terminal.
Added a BYOK model operation to the Freebuff SDK that reuses a connection's endpoint while minting an independent key.
Added a /todo slash command that opens a live checklist panel showing the root agent's current to-do list.
Scoped the programmatic scroll guard so user wheel events are not swallowed by no-op auto-scrolls.
Drew the model price sort so discounted ties break by regular list price, matching desktop and web ordering.
Removed the GLM 5.3 Flash deal-ending notice from the catalog after the September 30 promotion ended.
Retired MiniMax M3, GLM 5.2 and OX Alpha from the Freebuff model catalog for free users.
Added Desktop billboard ad slots with defined artwork shape and sizing requirements for advertisers.
